title: Fuel files
subtitle: Fuel card and tanker files: upload, map accounts, and send their batches for review

upload.title: Upload a fuel file
upload.description: The file is read first and nothing is stored until you apply it. Rows of a confirmed account form batches; the others wait in Unmatched.
upload.usageHint: How the vehicles used this fuel. On-road is preselected; change it for off-road machines or generators.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than {megabytes} MB.
upload.previewSummary: {read} rows read · {refused} refused · {duplicates} already stored or repeated
upload.unrecognised: Fuel names no rule recognises — these rows wait until the name is mapped
upload.rowIssues: Rows that will not be stored
upload.deliveriesHint: Declare each delivery's fuel, usage and month. Nothing is preselected; "Copy to all" repeats one delivery's choices.
upload.deliveryStored: Already stored by an earlier upload
upload.declareAll: Declare every delivery before applying the file.
upload.resultSummary: {formed} batches formed and {joined} open batches joined.
upload.stillProcessable: {rows} rows can still be processed. Open Uploads to continue.
upload.nothingToForm: Nothing new to form: the file's rows are already stored, wait in Unmatched or are excluded.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.description: Each applied file and where its rows stand. Held rows are tried again only when their holder asks.
uploads.empty: No fuel file has been uploaded yet.
uploads.takenOver: You now hold the upload's rows that are in no batch.
uploads.withdrawDescription: Rows in no batch — one account’s, or those waiting for one fuel name — are withdrawn with your reason. They stay on record and count nowhere. To count an associate’s excluded rows once it is a controlled company, withdraw them, change the account’s company, and upload the file again.
uploads.withdrawNone: No row of this upload is yours to withdraw.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Each card or delivery account and the company its fuel belongs to. A confirmed mapping sends the account's rows to that company's batches.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.excludedNote: This company now holds records, but rows excluded while it was an associate stay excluded. Upload the file again to count them.

tray.accountsDescription: Confirm or map an account to release its rows; then form their batches from Uploads.
tray.noAccounts: No rows wait for an account.
tray.namesTitle: Rows waiting for a fuel name
tray.namesDescription: These product names match no fuel rule. Their rows wait and are counted nowhere.
tray.noNames: No rows wait for a fuel name.

batches.title: Batches
batches.description: One batch per invoice and usage. A batch is submitted, reviewed and approved as a whole; its records are never acted on one by one.
batches.author: Author
batches.varianceLabel: Variance reason (needed when a figure is flagged)
batches.variancePlaceholder: Why this invoice differs from the earlier ones
batches.attached: File attached to every record of the batch.
batches.withdrawn: Batch withdrawn. Its rows stay readable; upload the file again to replace them.

approver.super_admin: A super admin of its company
approver.author: Its author (a masterkey)

review.empty: No fuel batch awaits a decision.

entry.stationaryLine: Filed under stationary combustion: saved as a Fuel record.
entry.cardFuelNote: Fuel bought with the group's fuel cards (Shell, Petrol Ofisi) and uploaded centrally is counted for the card's account holder — do not enter it here again.
entry.openBatch: This record belongs to a fuel batch: open the batch on Fuel files to change it.
